name: Hydra Heart
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 11th; Slot none; Price 3,300 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This date-sized piece of jerky looks like the shrunken heart of a large animal. A character who eats it (a full-round action that provokes an attack of opportunity as if drinking a potion) gains the effects of a heal spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, heal; Cost 1,650 gp.

or

Craft (cooking) 5 ranks, one hydra heart; DC 21; Cost 0 gp.
